items.org: Institute of Industrial & Systems Engineers (IISE), Waterloo chapter
items.what: Restarted the chapter after a 3-year hiatus. Raised $16,000 from faculty, the department, EngSoc and private sponsors, led two delegations to the IISE national conference (we won 2 of 4 competitions), and started a first-year mentorship program, including the scripts that matched mentors to students.
Helped run the club, and built its websites: a Django + Vue recipe and events site, then a React rebuild.
Built the club's website in TypeScript and Tailwind, including tournament logistics.

items.org: UW Analytics Group for Games and Sports

items.what: Six years. Led a squadron-wide trip for 50 cadets on a $2,500 budget, and taught cadets of different ages everything from leadership to survival skills.

Ran my high school's AV team. Rebuilt admissions and team events (92% member retention), trained 25 members on the equipment, and directed a 40-student seminar series that earned Club Executive of the Month.
